title: Petrol compatibility: check octane and ethanol separately
meta_description: Check petrol octane and ethanol separately before importing: match the engine manual, local fuel specification and market-specific compatibility evidence.

summary: Two petrol pumps can display similar-looking numbers without describing the same fuel requirement. A number attached to an octane scale answers a different question from an E-number describing ethanol content. For an imported petrol vehicle, compatibility therefore needs two separate comparisons: the engine's octane requirement against the destination fuel's octane specification, and the manufacturer's ethanol allowance against that fuel's blend description.
